fallback.rootCause: ACP analysis was unavailable or could not be machine-validated. No root cause is being asserted to avoid misleading the developer.
fallback.suggestedFix: Review the failure log and re-run the failed step. Re-run the Pipeline Assistant after ACP is available; no automated fix is recommended from this fallback.
fallback.noOutputRootCause: ACP produced no usable machine-validated diagnosis. No root cause is being asserted.
